messages:
alex_cs: quick day0 preflight for TigerBay private deploy — pasting top 4 gaps we hit on the dryrun.

maria_se: thanks. short is good, i'll open a ticket once you post.

alex_cs: 1) egress to splunk collectors missing (hosts + CIDRs below). 2) KMS key policy needs cross-account role grant. 3) redwood-s3-uploader role not in bucket policy. 4) audit-forwarder lambda timed out on dryrun. also customer asked about a Q4 discount tied to an SLO commit.

sam_infra: paste the hostnames/CIDRs and i'll raise a netops change.

alex_cs: hostnames: splunk-logs.tigerbay.internal, splunk-collector-02.tigerbay, splunk-s3-forwarder.tigerbay. CIDRs: 10.12.0.0/22, 198.51.100.0/24.

sam_infra: ok opening NET-XXXX for egress. target: EOD PST.

leah_eng: for KMS principal, which ARN did they request?

alex_cs: arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/tigerbay-service-role plus DescribeKey.

leah_eng: snippet for their key policy I can send: ```{"Sid":"AllowTigerBay","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/tigerbay-service-role"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"*"}```

maria_se: on S3 role — do we have redwood uploader ARN?

alex_cs: they expect arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/redwood-s3-uploader. need PutObject on prefix logs/tigerbay/.

sam_infra: i'll validate bucket policy and add tight PutObject for that role by tomorrow noon PST.

alex_cs: lambda error: `Runtime.TimeoutError: Lambda handler timed out after 30.00s` on rbw-audit-forwarder-prod.

leah_eng: short-term: bump timeout to 90s and add retry. i'll PR today. long-term: optimize upload path.

maria_se: creating CS-xxxx with owners: sam_infra (egress + bucket), leah_eng (KMS + lambda), alex_cs (customer coordination + renewal ask). tagging SalesOps for discount discussion (do not commit).

opsbot: IncidentBot: CS-xxxx created by maria_se — TigerBay day0 preflight items. Priority: P2.

alex_cs: final asks: confirm NET change applied (especially 198.51.100.0/24) and can someone draft a 30-min cutover checklist I can send ops?

sam_infra: will confirm once NET change is deployed.

leah_eng: i'll post a 5-step 30m runbook in ~30m.

maria_se: thanks team — updating account page with renewal_risk: moderate. will follow up on ARNs and KMS rotation plan.

alex_cs: :thumbsup: will monitor here and report blockers.
